info.name: User and Access Management Application Roles API
Returns a list of application roles.

params.name: assetKey
params.description: The asset key that the application role belongs to.

params.name: environmentKey
params.description: Filters application roles by environment key (stage). Mutually exclusive with `environmentKeys`.

params.name: environmentKeys
params.description: Filters application roles by environment keys (stages). Comma-separated list of environment keys. Mutually exclusive with `environmentKey`.

params.name: portfolioKeys
params.description: Only returns application roles in environments belonging to the specified portfolios.

params.name: sort
params.description: Used for sorting the list. Ascending by default. Prepend a hyphen, "-", to get a descending sort, for example "-name". Default: name. Allowed: name, environmentKey or assetKey.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results returned. Allowed values: 1 to 100 Default value: 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset of the first result returned. Default value: 0.

items.docs:
Returns a list of application roles that match the specified filters. Use query parameters to refine the search.

API Client needs the **User management > View end users** permission.

info.name: Returns the list of users for the specific application role.

params.name: nameOrEmailContains
params.description:
Filters users by name or email address. Parameter value must be URL-encoded (percent-encoding) to ensure it's correctly interpreted by the server. Example: Searching for an email with a +
            
 Incorrect: .../users?email=`john+doe@example.com`.
            
 Correct: .../users?email=`john%2Bdoe@example.com`

params.name: nameOrEmailOrUsernameContains
params.description:
Filters users by name or email address or username.. Parameter value must be URL-encoded (percent-encoding) to ensure it's correctly interpreted by the server. Example: Searching for an email with a +
            
 Incorrect: .../users?email=`john+doe@example.com`.
            
 Correct: .../users?email=`john%2Bdoe@example.com`

params.name: lastLoginAtSince
params.description: Only returns users whose last login occurred on or after the specified date and time.

params.name: lastLoginAtTo
params.description: Only returns users whose last login occurred before or on the specified date and time.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results returned. Allowed values: 1 to 100 Default value: 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset of the first result returned. Default value: 0.

params.name: sort
params.description: Used for sorting the list. Ascending by default. Prepend a hyphen, "-", to get a descending sort, for example "-name". Default: name. Allowed: userKey, name, email, status, lastLoginAt.

params.name: embed
params.description: List of fields to embed in the response.

items.docs:
Returns a list of users that match the specified filters. Use query parameters to refine the search.

API Client needs the **User management > View end users** permission.
